description: This file declares the IdentityCredentialStore class, which implements the BnIdentityCredentialStore interface for managing identity credentials in Android hardware. It includes method declarations for creating and retrieving credentials, and references external hardware proxy components.

classes.name: IdentityCredentialStore
classes.description: Implements the BnIdentityCredentialStore interface to handle identity credential operations, utilizing hardware proxy factory for secure hardware interactions.

methods.name: getHardwareInformation
methods.description: Retrieves hardware information related to the identity credential store.

methods.name: createCredential
methods.description: Creates a new identity credential based on document type and test credential flag.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Retrieves an existing credential based on cipher suite and credential data.
